description: Find EV charging stations where you can charge and pay with the Elton app, along a road (in driving order, with km, spread along the whole road) or in a town. Each comes with its address and coordinates, its most powerful charger, the places to eat and food shops within a short walk, and a link to its page. Each station's appUrl opens it in the Elton app, and a road's appUrl opens it in the app's route planner. Never prices.

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

food.description: Only stations with this place to eat or food shop nearby, by name, chain or cuisine, as "Burger King", "Rema 1000" or "pizza".

limit.description: At most this many stations: 10 if not given, 50 at most.

minKw.description: Only stations with a charger of at least this many kW.

place.description: A town, as "Trysil", or in Norway any place, as "Beitostølen": with no town page, the stations within 15 km of it.

withFood.description: Only stations with a place to eat or a food shop nearby.

name: find_charging_stations
title: Find charging stations
